title: The Fast Trick to Multiply Any Number by 9
description: A shortcut for multiplying by 9: multiply by 10, then subtract the original number once.
narration_lines: Forty seven times nine? Here's a shortcut that works for any number.
First, multiply by ten. Forty seven times ten is four hundred seventy.
Now subtract the original number once. Four hundred seventy minus forty seven is four hundred twenty three.
So forty seven times nine is four hundred twenty three, every time.
